steps: 1. Spawn a fresh **Chaos Warrior** in a solo mission.
2. With **Godmode** off, strike its armoured body using an attack that normally deals zero damage through armour.
3. Enable **Godmode** and **9999 Damage Per Strike**, spawn a fresh Chaos Warrior, and repeat the same body strike.
4. Turn Godmode off, spawn another fresh control, and repeat once more.
5. Run `/gt_regression_test`, exit normally, and attach the newest log.
assertions: With both options on, an armour-zeroed hit deals 9999 damage and kills the fresh Chaos Warrior; both disabled controls retain native damage. A visible weapon bounce may remain because sweep stopping happens before damage resolution. Hard invulnerability and authored no-damage targets are not part of the promotion.
Harness: spawn Chaos Warrior, deal a body hit with godmode and damage child on: health removed 9999 and unit dead; both off: zero damage.
